verdict.rationale: CDP documents a public API reference with concrete endpoints, such as the Checkouts API, which creates a checkout and returns a payment URL. The sandbox uses the same endpoints and authentication as Live, the CDP CLI exposes every API endpoint as a tool, and official SDKs give programmatic access. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404 at all standard paths), independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Creates a new checkout. Returns a payment URL to redirect your customer to. Each checkout is single-use.
It uses the same endpoints, authentication, and response formats as Live, so there's nothing new to learn when you're ready to ship.
The CDP CLI includes an MCP server (`cdp mcp`) that exposes every API endpoint as a tool.
